name: skill-orchestrator
description: Analyze screenplays, direct verified scenes, and compile sealed shots into one-shot-per-paragraph Chinese DOCX documents.

interface.shortDescription: Evidence-first screenplay direction with one-shot-per-paragraph DOCX delivery.
interface.longDescription: An evidence-first screenplay and directing pipeline for Codex. The prompt-free scene director seals structured decisions, then a dedicated prose compiler renders one shot or subshot per Chinese paragraph in a table-free DOCX. Legacy XLSX materialization and the separate explicit Seedance compiler remain available without entering the default director workflow.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $ai-script-breakdown to establish stable screenplay evidence, $screenplay-scene-daoyanzu for prompt-free scene direction, and $screenplay-shot-prose-compiler for the default one-shot-per-paragraph DOCX. Invoke $seedance-shot-prompt-compiler only as an explicit downstream step.
